purpose: Frozen inputs whose bound bytes are attested only by the freeze record because they were never committed to git. Listing an input here does not refresh or alter its hash; it records why commit-bound verification cannot reproduce it and what evidence remains.

unrecoverable_frozen_inputs.remaining_evidence: The R1 terminal 11-event ledger, its five content-addressed responses, and the R2 freeze that binds the R1 freeze by hash remain verifiable.
